verdict.rationale: Parsec documents full Wacom tablet support with pressure and tilt, so stylus input does reach the host. It also ships an Android client. However, the Wacom support covers pen-tablet peripherals rather than touch or stylus on a phone or tablet screen, and listed input support is only keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Missing for 10: documented touchscreen-to-pointer mapping on mobile clients, stylus support on phone/tablet devices (e.g., Android pen), independent hands-on corroboration.
